release_notes:
1. Fixed Back Office Save Persistence: Resolved CSRF admin security token omission and form submission handler in the Back Office configuration form, ensuring all settings persist reliably across reloads.
2. Redesigned Advertising Platform Headers: Redesigned the Matrix View column headers with aligned platform icons, professional typography, and streamlined quick-toggle pills (All / None).
3. Enterprise Save Button Design: Standardized all save triggers across panels with a high-contrast, professional primary action design, spinner feedback, and clean elevation.
